data.heading: OfficialThing
data.text: An item that is officially issued by an Agent.

data.heading: Direction
data.text: The orientation of a line or movement.

data.heading: VersionedThing
data.text: An identifiable version of a managed object.

data.heading: ComparisonOperatorCode
data.text: A code representing a comparison operator.

data.heading: Code
data.text: A code value whose meaning is defined by membership in (or reference to) a code list.

data.heading: CodeList
data.text: A curated set of codes (a code list), maintained and versioned by some entity.

data.heading: AngleUnit
data.text: A specified system of units for angles.

data.heading: Angle
data.text: An angle defined by two lines.

data.heading: Bearing
data.text: The orientation of a line or movement, measured from north (0°) clockwise.

data.heading: ActivationStatusCode
data.text: A code indicating the activation status of an object

data.heading: DirectionCode
data.text: A code representing orientation of a line or movement.

data.heading: ITSObjectProperty
data.text: An object property to organize all object properties defined in all recognized ITS Ontologies.

data.heading: enteredBy
data.text: The Agent that entered the OfficialThing.

data.heading: fromCodeList
data.text: Associates a code with the code list that defines it.

data.heading: hasActivationStatus
data.text: The activation status of the object.

data.heading: hasJurisdiction
data.text: The jurisdiction associated with the object.

data.heading: hasRegisteredCode
data.text: Associates a code list with a registered member code.

data.heading: issuingAuthority
data.text: The Agent that issued the OfficialThing.

data.heading: managedBy
data.text: Associates a code list with a registered member code.

data.heading: ITSDataProperty
data.text: A datatype property to organize all datatype properties defined in all recognized ITS Ontologies.

data.heading: codeValue
data.text: The lexical value of a code.

data.heading: enteredOn
data.text: The date the OfficialThing was entered.

data.heading: hasImage
data.text: The binary content of an image embedded as base64-encoded bytes.

data.heading: hasMaintainer
data.text: The maintainer of the code list (free-text identifier; can be replaced with a richer organization model later).

data.heading: hasName
data.text: A human-readable name for the code list.

data.heading: hasUrl
data.text: The URL associated with the object.

data.heading: hasVersion
data.text: The version of the object.

data.heading: issuedOn
data.text: The date the OfficialThing was issued.

data.heading: lastModified
data.text: Date the code list was last modified.

data.heading: OWLSpecification
data.text: A specification of a concept using the Web Ontology Language (OWL) along with associated metadata. The specification should include both the natural language definition and the semantic OWL definition.

data.heading: hasOWLSpecification
data.text: Points to the OWLSpecification that formally defines the meaning of this Code.

data.heading: hasIRI
data.text: The IRI of the OWLSpecification.

data.heading: isComplete
data.text: A boolean value indicating whether the OWLSpecification fully defines the concept using semantic OWL syntax (true) or if there are textual semantics that are not fully captured in the OWL syntax (false).
